verdict.rationale: The evidence only implies voice choice. The multilingual guide says developers pick which TTS model speaks for the agent, and reusable configurations allow A/B testing of voices. Nothing describes the size of the voice catalog or support for third-party TTS providers; the multi-provider table covers LLMs only, not TTS. Missing for 10: a documented broad voice library, support for plugging in multiple or third-party TTS providers, voice configuration docs, and independent corroboration.
